mapper.select: select count(1) from club_info where apply_status = '1' and status = '0'
select count(1) from club_info where apply_status = '0'
select count(1) from club_member where status = '1'
select count(1) from club_activity where status = '1'
select count(1) from club_activity where status = '0'
select count(1) from club_fund_apply where status = '0'
select count(1) from venue_apply where status = '0'

select c.club_name as name, count(m.member_id) as value from club_info c left join club_member m on c.club_id = m.club_id and m.status = '1' where c.status = '0' group by c.club_id order by value desc limit 5
select cc.category_name as name, count(c.club_id) as value from club_category cc left join club_info c on cc.category_id = c.category_id and c.status = '0' group by cc.category_id

select DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, count(distinct a.activity_id) as activityCount, count(distinct s.signup_id) as signupCount from club_activity a left join activity_signup s on a.activity_id = s.activity_id group by month order by month desc limit 6
